record.question: What is the purpose of acid alcohol in Ziehl Neelsen staining process?
options: To decolorize non acid fast organism
record.explanation: Answer B: To decolorize non acid fast organism. In Ziehl–Neelsen staining, acid-alcohol removes carbol-fuchsin from non-acid-fast organisms while acid-fast organisms retain it. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/dpdx/diagnosticprocedures/stool/staining.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
